title: Bike Social Hour
body:
* Build Community * Hatch Ideas * Ride Bikes *
Join other bike-minded folks for drinks, food and community every Wednesday from 4-7 (or so). Bike Social Hour is a place where everyone is welcomed and embraced by our community. Just show up and hang out. That's it!
Family Night: all ages are welcome any night, but first Wednesday of the month is Family Night, when kiddos can expect extra activities & more other kids to play with.
5:30 pm - Open Mic. Special guest speeches and announcements.…

title: Thursday Night Ride
body:
TNR #607: Mitch
Thursday Night Ride is Portland’s longest-running weekly social ride, rolling out from Salmon Street Springs every Thursday night since 2015!
Routes and ride leaders change weekly, but expect an energetic, party-paced social ride with warmth and weirdness from our welcoming “rolling dive bar” regulars. Most rides feature regularly spaced park and store stops, generally leading to a lively end spot around 11 PM. Come prepared to have fun and celebrate cycling together—other…
